Captured stdout of the OpenTelemetry Python SDK ConsoleSpanExporter. Not hand-written.

opentelemetry-sdk version: 1.45.0
Captured on: 2026-09-29

Command (run from an empty temporary folder):

uvx --with opentelemetry-sdk python - > console.json <<'SCRIPT'
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import ConsoleSpanExporter, SimpleSpanProcessor

provider = TracerProvider()
provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(ConsoleSpanExporter()))
trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)
tracer = trace.get_tracer("detecttrace.fixture")
with tracer.start_as_current_span("invoke_agent triage") as root:
    root.set_attribute("case.id", "CASE-1")
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("execute_tool lookup_ip") as child:
        child.set_attribute("gen_ai.tool.name", "lookup_ip")
SCRIPT

Version check:

uvx --with opentelemetry-sdk python -c "import opentelemetry.sdk, importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version('opentelemetry-sdk'))"

Resource attributes were checked before saving: the SDK adds only telemetry.sdk.*,
service.name ("unknown_service:python") and a random service.instance.id UUID. Nothing
host- or user-specific, so no resource override was set.
